lines.text: Your boss offers you a free lift.
This intern said yes. Three sweaty months.
Dev's the new intern. His team lead, Priya, lives two lanes over.
Day one, she offers. You don't say no to your boss.
So Dev writes rules.
Rule one. Never take the front seat.
So he sits in the back. She looks like his cab driver.
Day four, he nearly tips her.
Rule two. Laugh at everything, even the radio jingle.
Rule three. Never touch the AC.
Three months. Sweating. Politely.
Plot twist. Priya has rules too.
Never cancel, he needs me. Keep the jingle on, he loves it.
She hates driving. And that jingle.
One Monday, both secretly bail.
Dev hides behind the gate. Priya hides behind her car.
Forty minutes. Nobody turns up.
The guard watches two adults hide from each other.
Lesson: if nobody can say no, it's not a lift. It's a hostage situation.
So they put the ride on an app. Arjun's car joined the pool.
The roster shares the driving. Skip today says no for you.
First morning without the jingle, they both laughed. For real this time.
If your boss drives you to work, try Sahyatri.
